stem.text: Which description of a eukaryotic gene is correct?

A.text: a sequence of bases that forms part of a DNA molecule and codes for a protein

B.text: a sequence of nucleotides that forms part of a DNA molecule and codes for a polypeptide

C.text: a sequence of bases that forms part of an RNA molecule and codes for a protein

D.text: a sequence of nucleotides that forms part of an RNA molecule and codes for a polypeptide
